tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rgyun sgrog bzhi grwa'i bca' tshe dge/ rgyun sgrog bzhi la bca' tshe/ spyir bstan pa bstan 'dzin la rag lus tshul sogs/ mdo rgyud bstan bcos las byung tshul rnams ni dge 'dun tshang ma'i thugs la mnga' bas zhib par zhu ma dgos/ bye brag bod kyi bde skyid phal cher kyang / mi'u rigs bzhi'am rigs drug sogs khungs ma rnams ma 'chol zhing mtha' 'khos kyi rtags cha lugs spyod pa la dar bar/ chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i 'phrul blon rnams dang bcas pa'i khrims yig chen mo bzhin yod skabs/ bstan pa dar zhing bstan 'dzin bshad sgrub rgyas pa/ rtsod dus dang mtshungs pa'i rang bzhin las de skabs bod la sgos kyi nyi ma shar ba lta bu zhig mchis kyang / slar las ngan gyi dbang gis ya rabs khyad par can rnams dmangs phal pa las kyang dman pa sogs/ bod kyi skye 'gro thams cad lus ngag yid gsum gdug can gyi spyod pa la mos shing 'gyur bas/ bstan pa bstan 'dzin dang bod ljongs kyi bde skyid rnams sngar dang ye mi 'dra ba'i dar rgud ci spyi 'drar song shes ldan gzur gnas rnams kyis bltas pas dge sdig gang byas las kyi me long la 'char ba ltar mngon du 'gyur ba ni spyi'i lo rgyus gnas tshul tsam dang / bye brag rang lugs la sa skya pa'i gdung rabs 'di spyi ring nas bzung nga dpal po che'i bar rigs rus khungs btsun zhing mi chos kyis che ba'i yon tan yod khar/ klu dbang sku mched nas bzung chos srid gnyis kas ngo mtshar mtho ba dang / rje btsun gong ma lnga nas bdag cag gi rnam 'dren dam pa de nyid kyi bar du byon pa'i gdung rabs rnams la gangs ljongs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa zhes mtshan don mthun pa lta bur byung 'dug kyang sku brgyud kyis phongs tshul ni/ 'phags pa rin po che dang ye shes 'byung gnas 'gro mgon phyag rdor sogs sku tshe mthar ma phyin par dag zhing du gshegs/

bdag nyid chen po sman rtse'i yul du sbas tshul bzung nas gdan sa 'di nyid dbu chen la gtod pa'i dus ngan de 'dra shar/ slar dkon mchog gi thugs rje bdag nyid chen po gdan sar phebs nas chos srid zung 'brel du bskyangs pas dge mtshan gsar tshes su gyur nas ti shrī kun blo yan la spyi la dbang bsgyur gyi gdung rabs su grags/ de thugs bsam rnam dag gi sgo nas bla brang go bzhir gdung rabs spel ba sogs kyis thugs bskyed de ltar mdzad kyang / mkhas btsun chen po sogs bzhi thog bla brang pa'i gdung brgyud dang po rdzogs/ de nas ta dben kun nyi sogs rin gong pa'i gdung rabs rdzogs/ de nas ti shrī kun dga' legs 'byung sogs lha khang bla brang pa'i gdung rabs rdzogs/ de nas slob dpon nyi ma dpal nas bzung dus mchod bla brang pa'i gdung rabs byon nas da lta'i bar ma chad tsam byung mod/ de dag la rim bzhin gdung brgyud mi 'byon pa sogs sku gegs chen po byung tshul ni/ sa lo chen po snyigs ma'i snang tshul la thugs skyo nas dgung lo zhe grangs tsam la dag zhing du gshegs par dgongs te/ sngags 'chang chen po sku na shin tu phra bar gdan sa'i chos khri la mnga' gsol mdzad de/ rje de nyid dgung lo bcu bdun pa nas bzung gdan sa 'di nyid kyi bstan pa'i me ro gso ba'i thugs dgongs gtad kyang / lha rdzongs pa sogs bstan dgra rnams nas sku srog la babs nye'i 'o brgyal zhus par brten kun spangs bya bral la thugs mngon du phyogs kyang / gangs ljongs bstan 'gro'i bde skyid thugs blos ma thong pa mang pos gsol ba btab ngor slar sngar mu bzhin thugs 'khur che bzhes gnang ste rim gyis gdan sa 'di'i snod bcud tshang ma je rgyas la song rung / dus ngan gyi dmag 'khrug mang ba sogs thugs ngal gyi rnam pas spa gro stag tshang du gzigs snang khyad par can shar ba'i tshe sku lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod du gshegs la khad mdzad kyang slar gdan sa 'di nyid dar rgyas kyi gnas tshul dang 'jam dbyangs sku mched sku na phra ba thugs la bzhag nas lo grangs kha shas zhing 'dir bzhugs rjes 'jam pa'i dbyangs mched sku nar son nas zhing khams brje tshul mdzad/

de skabs nas bzung chos srid gnyis char chos rje khu dbon gyi sku thog lta bu'i dpal 'byor ma mchis ka bstan 'gro'i don 'grub nges kyi rgya che chung 'bring chos grwa 'di la 'pho 'gyur cher ma byung mod/ gdung brgyud dkon mu kho nar mchis te/ yab rje sbas pa'i sangs rgyas la sras gsum byon kyang sgar chen dang sku 'bring gnyis ngo bo khyad par 'phags pa las chos srid la de tsam gyi thugs bskyed che ba zhig ma byung / 'jam mgon a mes zhabs ni/ rje btsun gong ma lnga dang cha 'dra ba'i mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzoms zhing lugs gnyis 'dzin skyong mdzad pa gang la bsam kyang gangs can gyi khrod na de bas lhag pa med pa ni blo tshad ma'i skyes bu rnams kyis bltas pas gsal zhing / mgon des nyi shu rtsa lnga nas gdung spel mdzad kyang bzhi bcu zhe bgrang bar sras mi mnga' bas gdung rabs shin tu nyag phra/ de sogs kyi sku rim la dmigs nas zla shar gyi yum sgrogs grwa nyer lnga ma 'di sogs sku rim gal che kha shas bskrun pas 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang phyug phebs/ rje de nyid dgung grangs bcu dgu pa'i lo sngags 'chang kun dga' bkra shis 'khrungs/ des btsun mo gnyis bzhes pa'i sne gdong ma la sras mi mnga'/ bco brgyad ma la maṅga'i mtshan can dgung grangs nga gcig tu phebs skabs bdag cag gi rnam 'dren dam pa de nyid 'khrungs/ mtshungs med de nyid dgung grangs nyer lnga'i khar kho bo dang / nyer bdun pa la nu bo sngon ma/ sum cu pa la nu bo rjes ma/ shar pa la sras gnyis bcas 'khrungs kyang da lta kho bo ma shi tsam las gzhan gyi gnas tshul de bzhin shar ba bcas/ mdor na sku rim gyis rgyab ma 'khyer tshe 'khon gdung 'di yang myur du chad 'gro ba'i snga ltas yang yang shar ba thugs kyis ma bzod par sngags 'chang kun dga' bkra shis kyis bla ma lha sogs lung ston pa mang po la bka' dri mdzad pas so so'i lung phebs mthun par/

grwa tog gser gsum nyin re bzhin tshar re bton tshe thugs bzhed 'grub tsam las gzhan bya thabs zad pa lta bu'i tshig kho na byung bar dper mtshon na ji srid thub bstan 'di ma rdzogs bar sogs yun de srid du gdung rabs mi chad pa'i sku rim la dmigs chos grwa lho nas sde snod 'dzin pa'i grwa pa bzhi re bskor res kyis gong bkod chos sgrog la nyin re bzhin gdan 'dren zhu bar mdzad nas zhal ngo dang nang zan grags gras la thob thang yod pa'i bzhes thug zhal ja gang 'gro bcas dang / nyin chas zhabs yon sogs bsnyen bkur gang zab mdzad nas nyin re bzhin rtsa 'don gnang ba'i rgyun nged rang lo brgyad dgu tsam lon nas kyang 'dug cing / de rjes su mchod gnas sbyin bdag gnyis ka la bar chad zhugs pa lta bus je lhod je yangs je ngan la song nas don yang tig la gzhig tshe sku rim mi yong ba'i khar dge 'dun rnams spyi sgos kyi thugs gnyer dang thugs brel chags che ba dang sbyin bdag rnams rang gis ma byung ba'i nyes pa mi mthong yang gzhan skyon mdzub mo'i rtse la khyer nas yul khyad par can la sgo gsum gyi sdig pa ji snyed cig bsags pas/ bstan pa gdung brgyud sde bcas la ched gtad kyi bgegs chags 'gal rkyen sgrub pa 'dra mo zhig 'dug don la me 'brug lor sngar yongs ma myong ba'i bags bshal sogs nad yams de tsam dang / lcags sprel la 'brum nag me 'bar gyis skya ser drag gzhan 'bring gsum g.yul byas pa lta bu dang / yab rje rdo rje 'chang sku tshe mthar ma phyin par dag zhing du gshegs pa dang / lo nyes btud mar byung zhing stod smad kyi bla tshong khag sogs phyag gnyer nyer mkho rnams la'ang rkyen ngan rim can byung ba dang / gdung brgyud kyi gzhi ma sger pa'i sras mo la bar chad gdon bskyed de lta bu byung ba dang / nged kyi nu bo gcong can gyi mthar tshe'i ma zin cing / rang phyogs bstan pa 'dzin nges kyi skyes chen rnams dang mthun phyogs phan grogs su re che ba 'ga' la'ang blo bur rkyen ngan gyis khyer ba sogs 'gal rkyen 'das zin pa ji snyed cig byung ba dang /

de rjes su'ang bden bzung med rung nged rang la rmi ltas ngan pa brgyud nas byung zhing ri bkra ngan pa/ pho brang skar khung steng bya rog tshang gsog pa/ sngar ma dran pa'i rlung dmar byung ba/ bla ma lhar bcas kyi lung bstan la'ang dogs cha yod tshul gsungs pa sogs byung dang 'byung 'gyur gyi 'gal rkyen ci mchis rgyun sgrog 'di kho na ji bzhin ma 'grub pa las byung gleng don mi 'dug kyang babs nas/ bla ma gong ma'i thugs bskyed kyi 'dzugs bkod gnang ba'i tshul sgrub mchod/ rgyud 'don bskang ba gtor bzlog sogs bde chen gling pa rnams nas mdzad rgyu dang thugs tshul dus ja/ dgong thun sde snod kyi gshar sbyangs bka' bstan sogs gsung sgrog gtor ma tshe chog kun rig rnam rgyal sogs chos grwa lho nas mdzad dgos tshang mar phyag gnyer sogs sbyin bdag gi rigs nas kyang zhabs tog zhu dgos tshang ma sngags 'chang chen po dang / 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyi ljags sgrig gnang ba'i deb gzhi so so dang mi 'gal phyin phyis kyi gdung brgyud so so'i zhal bkod ngo ma'am/ yang na rang rang gi 'dod rgyal ma yin par de dang mthun pa'i deb gzhi las tshan so so'i bkod nang bzhin zhabs tog rgya che dpangs mtho'i tshul du zhus na lha bla ma mo kha rtsis sogs gzhan la babs pa'i rim gro gtor chung ma tsam zhig ma byung kyang gong bkod de dag gi thugs rjes bstan don lar rgya tshang ma gang la ci 'dod yong gras su 'dug kyang / rtsa ba bag nyal gyi yal ga lo ma shin tu rgyas pa 'di ni mchod gnas rnams 'o brgyal zhing / bstan don la'ang 'phral du phan thogs pa zhig mi yong 'dug pa nas nged rang gi thog la chos grwa lho byang gi las tshan/ phyag gnyer sogs nye 'khor ba tshang mar de bzhin gyi gnas tshul rang sems la 'gyod pa med cing gzhan rna ba bshas pa'i tshul du mol bzhin yod pas/ des na da lam yang gdung brgyud mi chad pa'i rim gro gal che dmigs gsal gyi tshul du 'jam mgon dpal ldan chos skyong sogs dam pa mang po'i gsung brtag la babs pa'i grwa tog gser gsum rgyun 'don dgos tshul gsar 'dzugs ma byas par rnying pa sngar 'khyun la nyams gos zhus pa yin pas/

da phyin chad rang re'i 'khon gdung 'di ma chad tsam dgos na chos sgrog pa dang zhabs tog pa gnyis char nas sngar gyi ba lang rkyang shul ma yin pa'i lhag bsam che bskyed byed dgos gras la dge 'dun tshang mar zhabs bskul dang phyag dpe dpe khri bzhugs gdan sogs yo byad chud zos la mi 'gro zhing brjed 'phrul sogs kyi do dam lde chung pa rim can nas byed cing / bka' 'gyur dus 'phar sogs sngar nas btsun chung 'byon srol yod rigs thams cad la'ang / deng phyin chad grwa bgres rnams kho na 'byon rgyu bcas la ngos sogs mi ngo rnams nas yang yang bskul ma dang bkod pa byas kyang mchod gnas las byed tshang mar phan mi thogs khar phan tshun khengs grogs las mi 'dug pas 'o skol tshang ma sdig bral bkra shis pa'i phyir/ phyar mo che sne bzhi nas 'degs pa'i bsam 'khur ga'u lo gru bzhi chud zos su ma song bar mdzad 'tshal/ zhes pa sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos rang gzhan la phan pa'i bsam pas bris pa 'di la rdzun dang zol zog g.yo rgyu'i tshig gcig kyang yod med drang po'i blo ldan rnams kyi gzigs su gsol/ /sarba maṅga laṃ/ sa stag zla 4 tshes 11 la bzhi thog pho brang gi yang steng nas bris/ yi ge pa ni gzhu 'od do/ /zhus so// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ rgyun sgrog bzhi grwa'i bca' tshe/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
